main_subject.detail: Two YSL The Slim Couture Matte Lipstick units stand upright on a glossy black base: one closed case on the left with the gold YSL monogram band, and one open lipstick on the right showing a squared orange-red bullet tip. Top logo reads 'YvesSaintLaurent BEAUTE'. Bottom copy reads 'YSL THE SLIM COUTURE MATTE LIPSTICK' and 'SẮC ĐỎ MAY MẮN, BỪNG KHÍ CHẤT ĐẦU NĂM'.
